name: security-review
description: Review application security and privacy boundaries.
---

# Application Security Review

1. Map assets, actors, trust boundaries, and abuse cases.
2. Check authentication, authorization, privilege escalation, and session handling.
3. Check input validation, output encoding, injection, CSRF, and upload handling where relevant.
4. Check secret exposure, dependency risk, logging, and personal-data minimization.
5. Verify admin-only operations are enforced server-side.
6. Report reproducible findings with severity, impact, evidence, and remediation.
7. Do not claim a security audit is complete if any relevant area was not tested.
